title: Measured Coupling for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.08307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models can write many tokens per step, but must choose which tokens are safe to commit together. Mean-field decoding penalizes pairs of positions whose predictions look alike. We replace this proxy with the coupling itself: how much committing one token changes the model's confidence at another. Cheap probes inside the main forward pass measure it, with no training or extra model, and it plugs into the same mean-field rule. On three models and four benchmarks, our method needs far fewer steps than mean-field decoding and is faster in most settings, also with a key-value cache, at an average accuracy cost of 1.1 points. Shuffling the couplings or replacing them with a uniform bonus loses this gain.

translated_title: 面向扩散语言模型并行解码的测量耦合方法
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型可以在每一步生成多个token，但必须选择哪些token可以安全地一起提交。平均场解码会对预测结果相似的位置对进行惩罚。我们用耦合本身来替代这一代理指标：即提交一个token会在多大程度上改变模型对另一个位置的置信度。主前向传播内部的廉价探针即可测量该耦合，无需训练或额外模型，并且可直接接入相同的平均场规则。在三个模型和四个基准测试上，我们的方法所需步数远少于平均场解码，且在大多数设置下（包括使用键值缓存时）速度更快，平均精度损失仅为1.1个百分点。若打乱耦合或将其替换为统一的奖励，这一增益将消失。
tldr: 该论文提出利用主前向传播中的廉价探针直接测量token间的耦合强度（即提交一个token对其他位置置信度的影响），以替代平均场解码中的相似性代理指标，使扩散语言模型并行解码在平均仅损失1.1个点精度的代价下大幅减少解码步数并提升速度。
en_tdlr: This paper replaces the similarity proxy in mean-field decoding with directly measured token coupling—how much committing one token changes the model's confidence at another—using cheap probes inside the forward pass, enabling diffusion language models to decode in far fewer steps and run faster with only a 1.1-point average accuracy cost.
